Remark
[existence for Ricci flow with surgery] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Remark 5\group Kleiner–Lott Singularities and Surgery For a nonaspherical irreducible initial manifold, surgery preserves a component homotopy-equivalent to the presurgery manifold while other components are spherical. A homotopy equivalence from nearby presurgery slices to the surviving component can be chosen with distance expansion $\xi (t')\ra 1$ as $t'\ra t$; the same control applies at later singular times.
